events.title: Vitruvian Salsa Festival 2025
events.address: Vitruvian Park 3966 Vitruvian Way Addison, TX 75001 United States
events.description:
The Vitruvian Salsa Festival returns to Addison, Texas, for its 11th annual celebration of Latin music and dance. 

Held every second Saturday from June through September, the festival offers a vibrant evening of live salsa bands, DJ sets, dance lessons, and a variety of food trucks. Each event runs from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM, with free salsa lessons starting at 6:30 PM, followed by live music at 7:00 PM. DJ Ruben Reyes keeps the energy high throughout the night. 

The 2025 lineup includes Havana NRG on June 14, Latin Swing on July 12, Zone D'Mambo on August 9, and Yamilka G & Orquesta on September 13. Admission is free, and parking is available for $15 (cash only) at designated lots. Attendees are encouraged to bring their dancing shoes and enjoy an unforgettable summer evening under the stars.

events.title: BIG Texas Salsa & Bachata Latin Dance Festival 2026
events.address: Hilton Anatole Resort 2201 N Stemmons Fwy Dallas, TX 75207 United States
events.description:
The BIG Texas Salsa & Bachata Latin Dance Festival is a four-day Latin dance event taking place over Labor Day Weekend 2026 at the Hilton Anatole Resort in Dallas, Texas. From September 3–6, 2026, dancers from around the world will gather for an immersive experience featuring world-class workshops, electrifying performances, and vibrant social dancing that extends into the early morning hours.

Attendees can choose from a variety of passes, including options for single nights, full days, or the entire weekend, with VIP upgrades available for those seeking an enhanced experience. The festival caters to dancers of all levels, offering beginner-friendly classes as well as advanced challenges, ensuring everyone finds their groove.

Set within the luxurious Hilton Anatole Resort, participants will enjoy spacious ballrooms, indoor and outdoor pools, a lazy river, and a plethora of dining options, creating the perfect backdrop for this unforgettable dance event. Whether a seasoned dancer or new to the scene, the BIG Texas Salsa & Bachata Latin Dance Festival promises an exhilarating and inclusive atmosphere to learn, dance, and connect with the global Latin dance community.
